This paragraph flows around the infobox floated to the right. Its lines are shorter while they are next to the infobox and use the full width again below it. Text keeps wrapping word by word, so the right edge of each line ends before the float starts. Some more words to make the paragraph long enough to reach below the infobox and show the full width again.


A photo floated left

This paragraph starts next to the photo floated to the left, so its lines begin right of it. Floats are taken out of the normal flow: the paragraph box itself still spans the whole width, only its lines get shorter. That is exactly how browsers do it.

A heading with clear: both

The heading above is below all floats because of clear: both.
